description: Configure the 'ne_countries' layer in the 'ne' workspace to ONLY advertise and accept requests in 'EPSG:4326' and 'EPSG:3857'. Navigate to the layer's configuration in the Web Administration Interface (http://localhost:8080/geoserver/web/, user: admin, pass: Admin123!), go to the Publishing tab, and modify the WMS Settings. Add only these two SRS codes to the limited list and ensure the response policy excludes all others.
